metas.name: Dope Thief
metas.description: Follows long-time friends and delinquents who pose as DEA agents to rob a house in the countryside, but end up unintentionally revealing and unraveling the biggest hidden narcotics corridor on the Eastern seaboard.

metas.name: Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking what really happened.

metas.name: Long Bright River
metas.description: A Philadelphia police officer searches for her sister, an addict who has gone missing.

metas.name: Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue
metas.description: A plane carrying ten people crashes into the Mexican jungle, leaving them stranded. As they are murdered one by one, the remaining survivors must solve the mystery of who is killing them.

metas.name: Doubters to Believers - Liverpool FC: Klopp's Era
metas.description: Midway through the 2023/24 season, Jürgen Klopp stuns Liverpool fans by announcing his departure. This series charts his final season and nine year tenure, showing how he turned doubters into believers and led the club to glory.

metas.name: Toxic Town
metas.description: When dozens of babies in Corby are born with disabilities, their mothers embark on a battle to hold those responsible to account.

metas.name: Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke
metas.description: Follows Ruby Franke, a former YouTube mom blogger with millions of followers who was sentenced to prison for child abuse.

metas.name: Su majestad
metas.description: Pilar, Princess of Spain and future queen of the country, is a troubled free-spirited party lover who is asked to save Spain of a possible scandal which affects to her family and it could ruin the royal institution.

metas.name: Berlin ER
metas.description: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin's toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.

metas.name: Grosse Pointe Garden Society
metas.description: Four members of a suburban garden club get caught up in murder and mischief as they strive to flourish.

metas.name: Zero Day
metas.description: In the midst of crisis, how can we discover the truth when it seems the world is being destroyed by uncontrollable forces? And to what extent are conspiracy theories our own inventions or products of our imagination?

metas.name: How I Escaped My Cult
metas.description: Go inside insidious modern-day cults through the unique lens of members who endured unspeakable trauma and the shocking investigations into these oppressive groups. With detailed, firsthand accounts from former cult members, their loved ones, and the investigators who helped bring these tormentors to justice.

metas.name: Win or Lose
metas.description: Follows a middle school softball team in the week leading up to their championship game, and each episode is told from the perspective of a different character.

metas.name: Good Cop/Bad Cop
metas.description: Siblings working as detectives in a small town navigate quirky locals, limited resources, their strained relationship, and their father, who's the police chief, in this comedic crime procedural.

metas.name: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer
metas.description: Hamilton County coroner Jeff Jellison launches a new investigation into Herb Baumeister decades after thousands of bones were found in the woods behind Fox Hollow Farms, Baumeister's stately home. Using new DNA technology, Jellison and his team work to identify the human remains, bringing long-deferred closure to victims' families and unearthing unsettling questions about potential accomplices, mi

metas.name: Apple Cider Vinegar
metas.description: The life of wellness guru Belle Gibson, who had a large social media following, where she pretended to be suffering from cancer but keeping the disease under control using self-care therapies. She confessed that none of it was true.

metas.name: Prison Cell 211
metas.description: Follows a riot that took place at a state prison in the Mexican border town of Ciudad Juárez on Dec 31, 2022 that left several dead.

metas.name: Love You to Death
metas.description: Raúl's world is unraveling. Marta's unexpectedly pregnant. After a funeral meet-cute brings them together, they stumble through the chaos of life and love.

metas.name: Shafted
metas.description: Follow Cédric, Tom, Jérémie and Tonio, four friends whose romantic and professional lives are turned upside down by the women in their lives.

metas.name: Prime Target
metas.description: A post-graduate mathematics student discovers an effort being made to destroy his work in finding a pattern in prime numbers that would allow him to access every computer in the world.

metas.name: American Primeval
metas.description: It follows the gritty and adventurous exploration of the birth of the American West, the violent collisions of cults, religion, and men and women fighting for control of the new world.

metas.name: On Call
metas.description: A rookie and a veteran officer patrol duo in Long Beach, California, face the morality of protecting and serving a community.

metas.name: Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action
metas.description: Jaw-dropping documentary goes behind the scenes of America's most controversial talk show to expose its biggest scandals, both on- and off-camera.

metas.name: Lockerbie: A Search for Truth
metas.description: Pan Am Flight 103 explodes over Lockerbie in 1988, killing 259 on board and 11 on the ground. Dr. Jim Swire seeks justice for his daughter Flora, a passenger on the plane.

metas.name: Missing You
metas.description: Detective Kat Donovan's world unravels when she finds her estranged fiancé on a dating app. Leading her to reopen her father's unsolved murder.

metas.name: Cunk on Cinema
metas.description: Philomena Cunk explores the history of film, from early cameras and 1960s New Wave to CGI and artificial intelligence.
